assets.prompt:
Edit the supplied body illustration into a VERY SIMPLE flat medical body-map icon, not a realistic anatomy drawing.
Keep the full body straight front view, separated legs, relaxed arms held a little away from the sides, overall proportions and full head-to-feet framing.
Remove ALL muscles, skin texture, tonal shading, nipples, chest anatomy, finger wrinkles, tendons, realistic facial detail and dimensional rendering. The torso should be an empty neutral shape. Use one graceful clean muted warm-gray contour line to outline head, neck, shoulders, torso, arms, simplified five-finger hands, legs and feet. At most a few small economical joint indication strokes. No organs, no sex characteristics. Like a high-quality simple body diagram printed on a medical examination form, not a gym illustration, not a person photograph and not a 3D model.
Use smooth restrained linework with only slightly varying thickness, visible at 140px wide. The drawing's interior is transparent or extremely faintly tinted; background and all gaps must be genuinely transparent alpha, no white rectangle, paper texture, shadows or glow. No words, no marks, no labels. Entire head, hands and feet visible.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: transparent raster decal for an aged paper medical form.
Create a highly convincing flat scanned DRIED BLOOD TRANSFER STAIN, blood only without any body or injury. A small asymmetrical rust-burgundy dried smear rubbed diagonally across absorbent paper, broken dark dense pigment islands, fibrous capillary feathering, irregular translucent thin edges, tiny gaps where dry paper fibers resisted ink, several scattered small droplets. Matte and absorbed, not glossy liquid, not thick paint. Uneven pressure and slight dragging, restrained real-world scale. Rich microtexture like a forensic scan, not a graphic symbol.
Composition: landscape 3:2, one cohesive stain cluster with generous transparent space around its irregular boundary. No paper substrate or rectangular colored patch: show only the stain pigment on TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, including transparent holes between fibers. Color must be muted dried oxblood and brown-red, never bright cartoon red. No objects, no hands, no text, no shadow, no checkerboard baked into image.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: transparent image decal of a dried water stain for layering over an old medical paper form.
A very realistic scanned water-damage tide mark, an asymmetrical irregular partial wash boundary after plain water soaked an absorbent paper and dried. Pale translucent grey-beige mineral and cellulose residue, thin uneven sepia capillary outlines with interrupted feathery edges and a few faint receding drying fronts. Very subtle granular microtexture. No pooled liquid, no gloss. The center is almost entirely transparent. Organic uneven shape rather than a circular coffee cup ring; one open crescent with a broad shallow wavy edge, a few small satellite wisps. This must be quiet and restrained enough that printed text underneath remains completely readable.
Composition landscape 3:2 with generous empty transparent space. Render ONLY the colored residues, with true alpha transparency throughout the empty center and the entire outside. Absolutely no paper rectangle, no solid white background, no shadow, no gray checkerboard graphic, no text, no objects, no bold cartoon outlines.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: blank portrait paper background texture for a medical record web interface.
Create a true top-down high-resolution scan-like image of one old, heavily handled sheet of ordinary thin uncoated medical record paper. Portrait page ratio 3:4. Full page visible, completely straight, no perspective. The sheet nearly fills the image with only about 1 percent transparent margin.
The central 94 percent must be pale warm ivory, largely clean, extremely subtle paper fibers and a couple of almost invisible fold-pressure lines, suitable to print a dense medical form on. Authentic paper, not parchment or leather. Concentrate the wear within the outer 1 to 2 percent at all four edges: tiny missing irregular nicks, short fine splits, frayed cellulose fibers, uneven warm yellow and occasional brown oxidized edges, softened heavily handled corners. One very small folded/curling corner. Wear should be visible yet proportionate to a frequently used document, not a theatrical burned treasure map. Gentle nonuniform age discoloration, shallow handling dents.
No printing of any kind, no letters, no table lines, no stamps, no blood, no water ring, no objects, no dramatic stains across center.
Background outside the entire irregular page silhouette and inside edge nicks MUST be real transparent alpha, not white or a checkerboard picture. No desk, no surrounding environment, no external drop shadow. Only the paper, tiny realistic self-shadows within curled fibers and corner are allowed.

assets.prompt:

Physically plausible flat absorbed pigment, fine capillary feathering, mottled rust-red interiors and dark burgundy drying rims. Very matte, no gloss or chunky crust. Composition: portrait 2:3, loose elongated diagonal arrangement with much clear negative space, largest drop only about 12% of canvas width. Do not crop any drop.
Only stain pigment, TRUE transparent alpha outside and between all drops. No paper patch, white mat, background glow, shadow, objects, text, checkerboard.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: transparent dried rain marks decal for an absorbent paper document.
Create a realistic scan of the subtle traces left by sparse RAINDROPS on paper after drying: around 12 small irregular pale beige-gray capillary outlines, of varied size, a few with overlapping half-rims and tiny feathered outward diffusion. Loose scattered arrangement, not an evenly spaced pattern. Empty transparent centers; the marks are thin discontinuous drying tide-lines with faint residual mineral granules. No visible wet water drops, no glass beads, no glossy reflections. Quiet barely-there residues, not coffee stains or bold brown circles. Scale like natural raindrops hitting a sheet left outdoors.
Composition: landscape 3:2, most space empty. Flat overhead scan realism, fine fiberlike outlines.
Render ONLY colored stain residue on TRUE transparent alpha; no paper sheet, no pale rectangular patch, no white background, no glow, no shadow, no text, no other objects, no checkerboard graphic.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: transparent edge-water-damage stain overlay for paper.

Landscape 3:1 strip composition, the trace runs horizontally across most of width but ends naturally inside frame, broad wispy residue beneath.

assets.prompt:

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: transparent artistic bloodstain decal on a fictional medical form.
Depict an altered dried blood WIPE pattern, clearly different from a new swipe transfer: an original irregular broad oval stain remains at left with a broken dark outer rim; a broad curved passage has removed much of its center, leaving a transparent swath, parallel faint streaks and a displaced lighter reddish residue dragged to the right. The alteration is the visual focus. Natural broken microtexture and slight capillary edges as if on paper, matte muted rust-burgundy pigment. Flat scanned stain, not brush paint, not an object or hand. Whole shape visible with generous margins, landscape 3:2.
Inspired by ASB TR 033 wipe concept: movement through a preexisting wet stain. Artistic example only, no claim of diagnostic accuracy. No crime scene, bodies, injuries, tools, labels or text.
TRUE transparent alpha everywhere without stain, including the cleared passage. Only residue, no paper rectangle, no white matte, no glow, no shadows, no baked checkerboard.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.

Entire shape flat and absorbed, no raised crust, no gloss, no unrealistic bright red paint. No explosive starburst, no droplets or drip trails, no handprint. The visual should be distinct from rubbing or splatter: soft irregular wicking.
